name: Taman Anggrek Speedcubing A 2022

venue.name: Mall Taman Anggrek
venue.address: Jl. Letjen S. Parman Street No.28, RT.9/RW.1, Tomang, Grogol Petamburan, West Jakarta City, Jakarta 11440

information:
Please note that this competition is paralel with Taman Anggrek Speedcubing B 2022, competitors can only register in either of the competitions. If this competition has reached the competitor limit, please register to the other paralel competition. Taman Anggrek Sppeedcubing A 2022 will feature Clock as its unique event.
We will not accept your registration if you haven't made both confirmation and payment to us. For more info, please check on the Registration Requirements.

_____________

Kompetisi ini paralel dengan Taman Anggrek Speedcubing B 2022, yang mana kompetitor hanya dapat mendaftar di salah satu kompetisi saja. Jika kompetitor limit sudah tercapai, silahkan mendaftar di kompetisi paralel lainnya, Taman Anggrek Speedcubing A 2022 akan memilki event unik yaitu Clock.
Kami tidak akan menerima pendaftaran Anda jika Anda belum melakukan konfirmasi dan pembayaran uang registrasi kepada kami. Untuk info lebih lanjut, silakan periksa Persyaratan Pendaftaran ( Registration Requirements.).
